# deployment-profile

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/deployment-profile.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `deployment-profile` component of `libs/platform`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.profile`: generated from its catalogue, [deployment-profile.json](../../libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/deployment-profile.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_`, `OIDF_ACCEPTED_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE` | `production`; one of `development`, `production` | The profile this process runs under: development, or production, which is also what unset means | **Not checked**: Anything but development, in any case and trimmed, runs as production; rar-model alone reads development only when it is written exactly so (F-0160) | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS` | Unset; a list | The risky switches this deployment accepts in production, comma-separated, each a risk id alone or with the last day it holds (expiry-log-mode@2026-12-31, UTC) | **Not checked**: An entry that is empty, not a risk this release knows, dated wrongly or past its date, repeated, or without the date a dated risk needs is not accepted, and the start-up audit lists it at WARN; under the production profile a switch that needs that risk then refuses its components | Any | Yes |
| `jdk.internal.httpclient.disableHostnameVerification` (system property) | Unset | The JDK's own switch, never this repository's: set, it turns off the host name check of every java.net.http client in the JVM - PingFederate's and every component's - for the life of the JVM. The JDK reads it once, in jdk.internal.net.http.common.Utils (JDK 17 and 21): unset checks host names, empty or true turns the check off, any other value checks. The production profile forbids it with any value (F-0035, F-0195) | **Doesn't start**: Set under the production profile, with any value: every component is REFUSED and answers 503, ready is 503, and PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving. Remove -Djdk.internal.httpclient.disableHostnameVerification from the JVM's options | Not in production: any value; refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` | Yes |
